routes.contextPolicy: Conservative application budget, not an advertised provider maximum; below the current Qwen API platform 131027-token listing. Revalidate deployment limits in Stage 7 before widening.
routes.imageTokenBudgetPolicy: Reserve 4096 tokens per image after local normalization to at most 1048576 pixels and 2048 pixels per side. Qwen3-VL uses 32x32 pixels per token; this reservation includes headroom for resizing and image markers.

routes.contextPolicy: Use the 256K context available to all K3-eligible memberships; K3's 1M context depends on the membership tier.
routes.imageTokenBudgetPolicy: Application admission estimate of 4096 tokens per image after normalization to at most 1048576 pixels and 2048 pixels per side; not provider-reported usage. Image count and byte limits are application limits.
